title: The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier & Clay
author: Michael Chabon
summary: Two cousins, a Jewish refugee from Prague and a Brooklyn writer, create a comic-book superhero in New York in 1939. Chabon follows their careers and love lives through the Second World War and the early comics industry.
readIf: you like sprawling historical novels about creativity, friendship and escape.
skipIf: you want a fast plot or do not enjoy long, richly detailed prose.
